name: Arcade
summary: Actions runtime for enterprise AI agents: agent authorization, agent-optimized tools (MCP servers) and governance, plus an open-source MCP framework.
description: Arcade MCP Gateways connect multiple MCP servers (Arcade tools and remote servers) behind one endpoint for an agent, app or IDE; a Gateway Assistant can create them via natural language. Pricing: Free plan at $0/month (no credit card); a production plan at $25/month platform fee plus usage (auth events $0.10, tool calls $0.01); hosted on Arcade Cloud or self-hosted via Helm. The arcade-mcp framework is MIT; no license is published for the platform itself.
